title: Yogi Berra's birth chart
metaDescription: Yogi Berra's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 21.4° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Cardinal signs carry five of the ten placements whose signs are settled — the broadest certain weighting in the chart. The four cardinal signs sit at the solstices and equinoxes — the scheme’s ignition points, and this chart is weighted to them.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 21.4° Taurus: the third decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Saturn. A earth sign, read here in its third face.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Aries (26.2°), Venus in Taurus (26.4°), Mars in Cancer (1.8°): a mind that decides at speaking speed, taste for the substantial and the lasting, drive that moves on certainty and current.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts the Sun a third of the circle apart from Jupiter, 1.1° off exact. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to. Behind it, the Sun square Neptune at 1.6°, and Saturn trine Pluto at 1.6° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has four entries for this chart. The Moon in Capricorn at 17.9° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Venus in Taurus at 26.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Cancer at 1.8° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Capricorn at 22.5° is in fall. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 earth, 4 water, 2 fire by element and 5 cardinal, 4 fixed, 1 mutable by mode. An earth emphasis reads as patience with material reality — slow hands, durable results. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Jupiter and Saturn were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Capricorn for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.5° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 17.9°.
